pts = sorted([(num('Knot measurements', f'B{r}'), num('Knot measurements', f'C{r}')) for r in range(702, 707)]); xs, ys = zip(*pts)
def interp(x, xs, ys):
    if x <= xs[0]: return ys[0]
    if x >= xs[-1]: return ys[-1]
    for i in range(len(xs)-1):
        if xs[i] <= x <= xs[i+1]:
            t = (x - xs[i]) / (xs[i+1] - xs[i])
            return ys[i] * (1 - t) + ys[i+1] * t
# integrate from 2 to 18 using trapezoidal rule with knot points in between
x_vals = [2.0] + [x for x in xs if 2.0 < x < 18.0] + [18.0]
x_vals = sorted(list(set(x_vals)))
y_vals = [interp(x, xs, ys) for x in x_vals]
integral = 0.0
for i in range(len(x_vals)-1):
    dx = x_vals[i+1] - x_vals[i]
    integral += dx * (y_vals[i] + y_vals[i+1]) / 2.0
result = round(integral, 2)
